thread:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to decide priorities for the next two-week aftercare window. Two competing asks: 1) a customer-reported regression that spiked error rate on generation endpoints (Jordan has details), and 2) a large enhancement request from Acme (requested by enterprise sales) that would be a big win but is ~3w of work. Thoughts?
Jordan (Support): Acme flagged the enhancement as a close-term blocker for their rollout. They said "without it, we delay". On the regression: about 0.8% failed responses across the cluster since yesterday (was ~0.1% baseline). Affects ~12 customers intermittently, but only two integrations show hard failures.
Sam (Eng Lead): For context, the regression stack points at branching in the request router after the latest routing kernel change. I can spare one eng pair for a 48–72h hotfix investigation. Full 3w enhancement will need design + 2 engs for a sprint.
Priya (SRE): From infra side, error spikes correlate with sequence length > 1k in the wild. We throttled a couple of noisy queues and saw partial drop. If we can release a small patch to the router, we should see error drop under SLO within a day.
Alex (Design): The Acme enhancement is heavier on UX — should not be shipped as a half-baked patch. We need at least a design spike to validate assumptions (2–3 days).
Maya (PM): Proposal: 1) prioritize regression as a hotfix (safety/regression > revenue win), 2) run a design spike for Acme concurrently, 3) negotiate a firm timeline with Acme (early beta in 3w). Acceptable?
Sam (Eng Lead): +1 for hotfix first. Can we scope the hotfix as a minimal revert/guard + telemetry to confirm root cause? If that works, we can return to feature prioritization.
Jordan (Support): I'll message the two impacted integrators with an ETA and explain we're prioritizing reliability. Also ask Acme if they'd accept a short-term compatibility workaround.
Priya (SRE): If we do the guard I want a canary with 5% traffic for 1h, metrics to watch: 5xx count, request latency P95, KV cache hit. I'll own the rollout steps.
Maya (PM): Acceptance criteria for hotfix: error rate back to <=0.15% for 24h, no regressions on latency >2x baseline. If hotfix fails, rollback and open incident. For Acme enhancement: design spike output = mockups + API contract + a rough effort estimate by EOD Fri.
Alex (Design): I'll start the spike and drop initial mocks by Thu.
Sam (Eng Lead): Engineering plan for hotfix: revert risky kernel change in router + add guard for seq_len > 1k to route to fallback model. Estimated 2 engineers, 2 days dev + 1 day test & canary. I'll assign Sam+Rae.
Maya (PM): OK assignments: Sam+Rae = hotfix, Alex = design spike, Jordan = customer comms, Priya = canary + rollout. Any objections?
Sam (Eng Lead): No objections.
Jordan (Support): Noted. I'll ping Acme and the two integrators now.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/hotfix-revert -> 5% traffic. CI: 14 checks.
Priya (SRE): Can we add extra logs around KV cache hits? Need better signal for correlation.
Sam (Eng Lead): Added. Patch includes an extra metric: router.kv_cache_hit_rate.
Maya (PM): Good. I'll update roadmap doc: move Acme enhancement to "candidate for next full sprint" with dependency on design spike.
Jordan (Support): Acme replied — they prefer reliability first; will accept beta in 3w. They asked for weekly progress notes.
Alex (Design): First mock pushed to FigJam: link https://redwood.design/figjam/abcd — quick feedback welcome.
Sam (Eng Lead): Monitoring looks good in staging. Ready for canary.
deploy-bot: canary started: 5% traffic -> hotfix-revert.
Priya (SRE): Canary metrics after 30m: 5xx down ~85%, P95 latency unchanged. Rolling to 20% now.
Maya (PM): This looks like the right call. After canary completes, we'll close the hotfix card and move the Acme enhancement to planning with targeted delivery in three weeks.
Sam (Eng Lead): Plan captured in the sprint board. I'll add a test to prevent this regression in future (seq_len edge case).
Jordan (Support): Customers updated. Acme wants weekly check-ins; I'll schedule.
Maya (PM): Thanks everyone — quick huddle in 30m if we need to unblock anything. :thumbsup:
